chosen_titles.rationale: Title 29B - Campaign Disclosure and Contribution: this is a new top-level title in the 2025 RCW index (didn't exist as a separate title in 2015) and the only title whose name directly names disclosure; possible new home for RCW 42.17A's lobbying-disclosure sections after a renumbering or split.

Title 42 - Public Officers and Agencies: historical home of RCW 42.17A (Disclosure - Campaign Finance, Lobbying, Records), which housed the unified lobbying-disclosure regime in 2015; checked in case Title 42 still hosts the lobbying chapter (or a residual subset) after the 2025 reorg.

notes: WA 2025 index shows a NEW Title 29B 'Campaign Disclosure and Contribution' that did not exist in 2015 (where RCW 42.17A lived under Title 42). The 2015 ground truth bundle put all lobbying-disclosure sections under title-42/chapter-42.17a. Returning BOTH Title 29B and Title 42 to let pass 2 discriminate whether the lobbying-side sections of 42.17A migrated to 29B, stayed in 42, or split. Per pass-1 Rule 2, returning all candidate titles is cheap; missing the actual title is structural failure.
